what: Nucor is the largest steelmaker in the United States. It melts scrap in electric arc furnaces rather than using blast furnaces, and makes sheet, bar, plate and structural steel plus finished products like joists, decking and insulated panels.
customers: Construction contractors, carmakers, equipment manufacturers, energy companies and steel service centres.
money: sheet, bar, plate and structural steel
joists, decking, rebar fabrication, buildings and racking
scrap processing and direct reduced iron
moat: Electric arc furnaces with lower fixed costs than blast furnaces, a variable pay model that cuts costs in downturns, and mills placed near customers.
risks: Steel prices are cyclical and drive earnings
Imports and tariff policy change competitive conditions quickly
New capacity from itself and rivals can oversupply the market
opportunities: Tariffs on imported steel support domestic prices
Data centre, factory and infrastructure building raises steel demand
Downstream steel products earn steadier margins than raw steel
watch: Steel shipments and the realised price per ton.
